guarantees.claim: block_addr_limit is assigned a KeccakCountW-cast value from KeccakRate[strength_i] for the five defined enum cases; for any other strength_i it is assigned '0.

assumptions.claim: KeccakRate must contain correct block address limits for each supported strength enumerated in the case items.
assumptions.risk: block_addr_limit may be incorrect or zero, producing illegal padding that could compromise protocol integrity or security.

uncertain_points.claim: The KeccakCountW cast may truncate KeccakRate entries if they exceed the target width, causing an incorrect block_addr_limit.
uncertain_points.risk: Padding may stop at the wrong offset, breaking the SHA-3 specification and possibly enabling length-extension or spoofing attacks.
